candidate_relations.rationale: The initial-operator tests verify an empty project requires a deterministic, mutation-free, exactly confirmed ceremony that creates one protected root, strengthening the orchestrator rule that bootstrap cannot itself create operator authority.

The initial-operator tests verify the explicit protected-root establishment ceremony and exactly one root after success, strengthening the operator-registry proposition about initial-root establishment.

The reconciliation contract requires immutable candidate-bound disposition under semantic-reconciliation activation and forbids admission or Canon mutation, strengthening the reconciliation tests’ fail-closed immutable-disposition boundary.

The installation guide keeps project knowledge, project rules, and project authority outside the managed .reasoning-distiller framework tree, strengthening the package-build exclusion of project-owned material.

Separating the installed framework tree from project knowledge, rules, and authority strengthens the migration requirement to preserve project ownership while replacing cross-repository runtime coupling.

The autonomous-workflow tests show materiality interrupts continuation before the next consequential mutation, strengthening the rule that grant authority cannot waive required materiality acknowledgement.
The autonomous-workflow tests show scope expansion and protected authority interrupt continuation, strengthening the workflow-contract rule that workflow intent itself grants no downstream authority.

The deterministic RGP validator covers record and relation vocabulary, provenance, premise references and cycles, and structural invariants, strengthening the fixture runner’s use of the current validator rather than schema parsing alone.

The runtime-isolation record shows installed runtime and installer operation need neither network nor a live source checkout after retrieval, strengthening the migration goal of replacing cross-repository runtime coupling with a local installed framework.

The role-registry tests show role changes create no semantic authority and unauthorized operators fail closed, strengthening the Steward-authorization contract rule that registration alone never grants Steward scope.
The role-registry tests show role transitions are separate from semantic authority, strengthening the runtime proposition that Steward authorization is maintained in a separate domain.

The deterministic-builder record requires an allowlisted reproducible builder with identical canonical manifest/content identity and unsafe-content rejection, strengthening the release-package builder proposition.
The deterministic-builder record’s explicit allowlist and excluded-content rejection strengthen the package-build configuration boundary around managed release roots.

Declaring the preserved Phase 0 baseline evaluation-only with no canonical memory or admission authority strengthens the boundary separating evaluation diagnostics from durable candidate and Canon state.

The Distiller core implements deterministic request construction, activation-bundle preparation, raw candidate preservation, validation, and immutable submission, strengthening the ingestion-operation proposition.

The Distiller core’s immutable candidate-submission implementation strengthens the proposition that submission identity is deterministically derived from invocation identity and canonical graph bytes.

The operator-management runtime separates ordinary operator changes from protected-root transfer planning, approval, validation, and application, strengthening the root-transfer tests’ protected ceremony model.

The mutation tests verify consumed approvals, stale bases, projections, and corrupted histories fail at the correct boundaries, strengthening the common mutation substrate’s exact immutable approval and state validation model.

Requiring independent apply-time validation even after grant-derived approval strengthens the common mutation substrate’s distinction between approval evidence and deterministic applicability validation.

The self-consumption workflow executes through the installed runtime with adjacent source roots unavailable, strengthening the migration requirement to replace cross-repository runtime coupling with the project-local installed framework.

The journaled-recovery record defines recovery as restoration or completion from durable local transaction state so interruption cannot leave an indeterminate tree, strengthening the installer-runner requirement to preserve or restore a known installation on failure.
The Rupi recovery handoff invokes bounded recovery only when required and then performs a fresh transition plan, strengthening the installer-runner fail-closed recovery boundary.
